The '''Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition''' is a Development Plan proposed by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division for Nazca Railway Development starting from 2024 in Season 4. It is divided into four parts, and was announced in phases on the Nazca Railway Discord Server starting from January 16 2024.

History

The Development Plan is split into Four Parts as follows:

Full Text (Part I)

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The first part of our plan focuses on the northern area of Los Sengas. This includes Odyssey, Intus Aquilo, and the expansive Ingress Continent.

Odyssey

Odyssey, a fresh development area in Los Sengas, is located to the west of Rover and northwest of Sava. At present, Nazca Railway operates 3 stations in Odyssey. Our new development initiative will transform this network into a comprehensive system with 8 lines.

Our enhanced network in Odyssey will feature a variety of lines for comprehensive coverage. This includes Line 44, a circular, 3 east-west lines (Lines 8, 28, 29), a north-south line (Line 21), and 2 Veloduct lines (Golf, Lima). This diverse array of routes will ensure that residents and visitors in Odyssey can easily travel in any direction using Nazca Railway.

Intus Aquilo

Intus Aquilo has transformed from a once isolated island to a thriving development zone, extending to the coastlines across from the island. Recognizing this growth, Nazca Railway is eager to collaborate with local developers to enhance the area's transportation network. Our goal is to strengthen local connections and provide additional routes to and from Intus Aquilo.

With the expansion of our network, the coastline opposite Intus Aquilo will see significant enhancements. A new circular route, Line 40, will be introduced, and Line 3 will be extended northward. Additionally, Line 26 and the will expand westward, with connections to the .

On the east side, Line 27 will extend from Peacen Island up to the northeastern areas of Intus Aquilo, offering greater access and connectivity.

Ingress Continent

Ingress Continent is set to become a key area in Nazca Railway's development plans. At present, our network primarily serves the southern part of the continent, with Line 16 stretching all the way to the continent's north pole along its western border. This expansion marks a significant step in enhancing our railway coverage in the continent.

North-South Routes: Line 16 will continue as a vital route across the continent. Additionally, two new lines with the same direction are planned: Line 15 to the east and Line 6 through the central region. For faster travel, Line 16X and the Veloduct will provide express services.

East-West Routes: Nazca Railway will construct Line 29, Line 26, and Line 25, each supporting the Glacier, Asylum, and Snowty regions respectively. The Veloduct will also offer express services, particularly complementing Line 26.

Gateway: The Ingress Continent houses one of Los Sengas's eight major gateways, named “”. This station is set to connect Line 15, 26, 29, and the , making it a key hub in our network.

Full Text (Part II)

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The second part of our plan is about the eastern region of Los Sengas, involving Egress, Yowah, Torrent, Clouds, Cometsilk and Prymea.

Northern Yowah, Egress & Torrent

The northern part of Yowah region lacks the service of Nazca Railway and this will change very soon with a plan consists of 5 lines.

During PreSeason 4 Phase 2, Line 7 () has extended to . In this plan, Line 7 will extend further to the east to Abunest in Torrent and turn north to . In addition, Line 7C will establish, it will connect Twintip Rivers Station and Prosand Station and the area in between.

Line 13 () and Veloduct will go straight east from Sand Martin Checkpoint, setting up stations along the islands and turn north around to .

The section between Zootuary Station and Sand Martin Checkpoint of the will switch service to a new Veloduct Line, , and extend to the east to and Abunest.

Last but not least, will extend northward from Pi Lake Station to via Abunest as well. When all 4 lines mentioned have service at Daisy Island, this station will upgrade as a Checkpoint.

Cometsilk & Prymea

The major development zone of the southeastern area are the southern region of Prymea. The main network expansion is around Line 17 (). Line 17 will extend southeast from Southern Heights Station and go all the way to the east to Borealis continent (a large piece of snow biome).

Moreover, Line 31 (), Line 45 () and Veloduct will also extend to the south(east) and meet Oasis Bay Line at Spring Point Gateway. Where Line 45 is a new line starts from Nail Bight Checkpoint.

Line 28 () will also extend southeast and interchange with Line 17 at the border of Borealis continent.

The Amber Line

There will be a new north-south line further east of . Stay tuned for further updates!

Full Text (Part III)

Nazca Railway is excited to share our upcoming development vision for Los Sengas in our 2024 edition. This plan highlights four key development areas, each with its distinct sectors.

The third part of our plan is about the southwest region of Los Sengas, involving Jupiter, Teraleros an western Xofa.

Jupiter & 22nd

The majority of Jupiter continental has been developed during Season 3 development. In this plan, Nazca Railway’s development plan in Jupiter will involve the islands in the Archipelago at Strait of Freedom.

To begin with, Line 17 () and will continue westbound to Joyhill Island and Sandshore Island. Line 17 will “land” on south side of 22nd continent and spurs around the southern part of the continent, as Line 17A (). The main line will go to the west while the spur will connect to Summer Point Gateway.

At the mean time, Line 9 () will proceed southbound from to interchange with Line 17 in both islands. After that, Line 9 will continue south towards .

will have a stop at Joyhill Island, interchangeable with Line 9 and Line 17, then it will go to Summer Point Gateway as well with a slightly northern path of Line 17.

In addition, Line 32 (), will follow the coastline of 22nd continent until it turns westbound. This line will end at Summer Point Gateway.

Teraleros

Teraleros (and future Poloros to the south) is a major development zone for Nazca Railway long term network expansion.

In the Teraleros, the northern part of the continent, will extend a number of existing lines including (but not limited to) Line 4 (), Line 9 (), Line 17 (), Line 35 (). Also there will be new lines such as Line 17A (), a new loop Line 33 () and more.

Also Nazca Railway will establish a new Terminal-class station called “Cityyard Shrine” which will be just south of Ontario Sound Station.

Western Xofa

The expanse of western Xofa is going to be included as well, to motivate the development of the region and its vicinity.

Line 11 () and Line 12 () will have further extension to the west side of the Peckern Continent. Line 11 will continue in northwest direction mainly and connect with Apple Hill Station while setting up interchange stations with Line 12 and . Line 12 will mainly go westward.

Furthermore, Nazca Railway will establish a new Veloduct, the . Starts at Centopia, heading west to Orama Island, central Xofa and to Apple Hill. This line is expected to have transfer with Line 11, Line 12 and Fox Line. <!--

title: Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors
safeHtml:
Nazca Railway is the first Minecraft Railway System in the world to widely adopt Platform Screen Doors for all its stations during construction and operation.

Technical Information

Nazca Railway Platform Screen Doors (PSDs) are based on the Vanilla Redstone System that came with Minecraft. The "Hardware" of the PSD mainly consists of glass, and redstone lamps are used as indicators for door status (Open/Close). Pistons, command blocks and redstone wiring are also designed in the fashion of a switch. Newer models of PSDs make use of "Platform announcements" and Flashing Lights to increase the convenience of passengers using Nazca Railway.

Usage

  • Prevent Water Influx into tarcks.
  • Prevent malicious/accidental breaches into the track area.
  • Prevent malicious attacks from other passengers when trains are arriving.

Platform Screen Door Type Description

Classic PSDs

Classic PSDs are designed for platforms and stations with high ceiling height. The Door indicators are located above the platforms, but this model does not support Platform Gates.

Classic.png|Classic PSDs Reverse_Classic.png|Reverse Classic PSDs </Gallery>

  • Applicable For: Platforms with High Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Classic PSD, Reverse Classic PSD, Classic+ PSD
  • Applications: Most PSDs at Urban Stations (Metropolis Terminal, Intus Aquilo Gateway etc.)

Basic PSDs

Basic PSDs are designed for platforms with low ceiling height. The door indicators are placed on the floor. This model supports Platform Gates.

Basic_Platform_Gate.png|Basic Platform Gates Basic_PSD.png|Basic PSDs Heightened_Basic_PSD.png|Heightened Basic PSDs </Gallery>

  • Applicable For: Platforms with Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Basic Platform Gates, Basic PSDs, Reverse Basic PSDs, Heightened Basic Platform Gates
  • Applcations: Most Ground, Pseudoground Station Platform Gates, Island Station PSDs (Metro Stone Station, Origin Station etc.)
  • I-River Station is the first station to use Heightened Basic Platform Gates.
  • Currently, Nazca Railway no longer builds new Basic Platform gates that are only 1 block high. All new Basic Platform Gates are of the Heightened Basic Platform Gate variation.
  • Originally, Katadelphia Station uses Basic Platform Gates that are 1 block high, but since the construction of Katadelphia City Center Node, the platform gates have been converted to the Heightened Basic Platform Gates that are two blocks high.

Liquid PSDs

The first prototypes of this type of platform gates are seen at Mangrove Pass Station of Terracept Division. Liquid PSDs are improved version of Classic PSDs. While they are also used for Stations with High Ceiling Height, the required platform width of using this design is reduced to zero. However, this design does not support Platform Gates.

Liquid.png|Liquid PSDs </Gallery>

  • Applicable For: Special platforms with High Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Liquid PSDs
  • Applications: Overground stations with Special Platforms (eg. Transparent Platforms, Platforms with Water/Lava Underneath etc.) (Congorge Station, Treeless Hill Station, Glacier Station etc.)

Aerial PSDs

Aerial PSDs can be seen as a combination of Basic Platform Gates and Liquid PSDs. It is designed to reduce the required width of Platform Gates. However, PSD variations for Aerial Platform Gates are also available.

Aerial_Platform_Gate.png|Aerial Platform Gates Aerial_PSD.png|Aerial PSDs Reverse_Aerial_PSD.png|Reverse Aerial PSDs </Gallery>

  • Applicable For: Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Aerial Platform Gates, Aerial PSDs, Reverse Aerial PSDs
  • Applications: Overground Stations or Island Stations with special Platforms (Miner North Station, TriPaw Station. Eagle Island Station etc.)

Open PSDs

Open PSDs look identical to Basic PSDs, except that no electronic circuit boards are required above the platforms. However, this design does not support Platform Gates

Open.png|The only known set of existing Open PSDs to date </Gallery>

  • Applicable For: Low Ceiling Height
  • Variations: Open PSDs
  • Applications: East Margin StationIn order to avoid affecting nearby terrain, this station is built at a high height of 115m and uses Plateau Station designs. Therefore, the Open PSD is designed specifically for that station.</ref>

Medjay Platform Gates

Medjay.png|Medjay Platform Gates </Gallery>

  • Used exclusively by Local Rapid Transits, Medjay Platform Gates are the simplified version of other platform gates. However, this set of platform gates does not support flashing lights.
  • Applications: All Local Rapid Transit stations.

The '''Nazca Railway Station Numbering and Directional System''' is a numbering system used by all current stations of the NR Los Sengas Division after the construction of Steep Pond Station.

Description

The Station Numbering of this system can be divided into two parts, namely Route Number and Station Number. For "Post-Zero Stations" ("Pre-Zero Station" start from the number "00", and increases with the increase in mD sign), the numbering order starts with Route Number, and followed by Station Number (eg. '''XX'''-YY). However, for "Pre-Zero Stations" ("Pre-Zero Stations" start from the number "01", and increass with the decrease in mD sign), the numbering order starts with Station Number, and followed by Route Number (eg. YY-'''XX''').

For routes featuring express services (eg. ), stations that support the Express Service would have a letter "X" appeneded to the route number for classification purposes. For instance, despite being an station, High Mesa Station does not have services. As a result, the station code for of that station is |'''3'''}}-01. However, since Intus Austrum Gateway of the same line features , the station code of that station is 07-|'''3X'''}}.

Morever, station codes are subject to changes announced by Nazca Railway, and Route Numbers have brackets inserted for clarification. If new stations were inserted between existing stations, all stations that are after the inserted station in the respective direction would have their station numbers adjusted.

It should also be noted that "Post-Zero Stations" and "Pre-Zero Stations" are formerly named "Up-direction Stations" and "Down-direction Stations". However, they are renamed to their current names after the completion of Centopia Development.

Station numbering for operates differently. The numbering of nodes are divided in 4 quadrant directions (Namely NW (North-west), SW (South-west), NE (North-east) and SE (South-east), as well as the order of construction of that node in chronological order. However, for Metropolis Terminal, the Station Number for is marked by the letter "O", signifying the Origin of .

Local Rapid Transit

Local Rapid Transits (LRTs) would not assign a route number for each individual route. Instead, the station numbers in the same LRT system are assigned with the same set of numbers, increasing in chronological order of construction or by development order of the route. Usually, numbers increase from the Downward Terminus of the routes involved.

It should also be noticed that there are no "Zero-Stations" (ie. (XX)-00) for LRTs and the first station would be marked (XX)-01.

title: Nick-train
safeHtml:
The '''Nick Train''' is an inspection train used by Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

Technical Information

Exterior and Outlook

  • '''Driver Cab Car Length''': 25000 mm
  • '''Normal Car Length''': 22000 mm
  • '''Width''': 3000 mm
  • '''Height''': 3750 mm

Variants

The first train: NS001 - NS002 - NS004 - NS003<br />The second train: NS011 - NS012 - NS014 - NS013<br />The third train: NS021 - NS022 - NS024 - NS023<br />The fourth train: NS031 - NS032 - NS034 - NS033<br />Spare Carriages: NS044, NS054

'''NS0x1''' (The first carriage): Features supersonic wave emisssion systems that detects defects on the track. This carraige also features signal testing facilities to test whether train signals are operating normally.

'''NS0x2''' (The second carriage): Features electric inspection facilities that checks whether electric supply is operating normally and whether there is sufficient space for rolling stocks to pass through a certain section.

'''NS0x4''' (The third carriage): This carriage is a VIP carriage that is used when senior members of Nazca Railway are performing inspections. This carriage is complete with a conference room and a pantry, and does not have to be used when performing daily inspections.

'''NS0x3''' (The fourth carriage): Features supersonic wave emisssion systems that detects defects on the track. This carraige also features signal testing facilities to test whether train signals are operating normally.

Application

Each depot features a Nick-Train to run on lines that is managed by the depot. Since this train is registered, tracks do not have to be closed when this train in operation so that other trains can run normally on existing tracks.

However, on routes that are not connected to other existing lines, this train can only use mini-robots that are not registered, and the entirety of the track section has to be closed. For instance, and make use of this inspection method.

title: North Tin Kam
safeHtml:
'''North Tin Kam''' is one of the Sub-Districts of Peckern North. It is located to the north of Tin Kam Station and the west of Dansein. North Tin Kam is an extension of the Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town, and includes the Mount Hittites Industrial-Commercial Area, Tin Kam Court and Tin Tung Court.

History

At the beginning of development of Shek Pai Tau new town, developers had plans to construct Tin Kam Estate in what is Tin Kam Pier today. However, after re-development, Lok Kam Estate replaced the plans for Tin Kam Estate.

However, the name "Tin Kam" is later resurrected at the northwest of Tin Kam Pier, and instead of the original public housing estate plan, it became a home ownership development.

Meanwhile, planning of the road network at Mount Hittites had also taken place to the east of Tin Kam Estate and had provided job opportunities for residents in that area. However, due to high commercial needs, and the fact that office buildings have a higher capacity for employed population, Mount Hittites incorporated the commercial portion as an industrial-commercial mixed use zone, and the road network had also been re-organized to incorporate the additive usage. Subsequently, Mount Hittites is drawn into North Tin Kam for management convenience.

Current Stage

Tin Kam Court

As the namesake public housing development of Tin Kam, Tin Kam Court with its smaller counterpart Tin Kam East Court, houses 58 40-storey Concord I residential buildings, providing a grand total of 18,560 units at the edge of town of its own. Planned facilities include a large shopping center, multi-phased carpark, sports center, community center, etc.

Tin Tung Court

The residential buildings planned at Tin Tung Court is rather more diverse, and based on medium density buildings across the globe. The development is phased in short without overall goals and for populations. Currently it comprises of 15 blocks, housing a population of 5115.

Sai Shan Industrial-Commercial Area

Development of Mount Hittites can be divided into three parts: The light industry section to the east, the commercial sector in the center and Siu Kam Estate to the west, which provides 7272 flats and serves a population of 20.4 thousand in its 10 buildings. The three parts are currently in constant development on its own.

safeHtml:
'''Northern Dansein New Town''', colloquially named '''North Dansein''', is a new town under construction in Peckern North. It is situated to the northeast of Tin Shek New Town and the north of Dansein, and is the auxiliary town of Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport.

History

Background

Among all the new areas in Peckern North, Dansein has seen the largest development.

While Dansein already had plans for large-scaled expansion using Dansein Market as the epicenter, with residential zone existing to the south, areas to the north of Dansein still had yet to begin planning of development. However, Dansein North development had been reconsidered after the relocation of Peckern Continental Eternity International Airport to the north of Peckern North.

Planning Details

According to the developers, it had taken an extended amount of time for projects in Dansein to complete, with some of them lasting over two years at most, but the products of the development were deemed inefficient relative to the time taken to do so. This may be due to the fact that large public housing estates and its societal demands need a lot of time to develop. Therefore, with this lesson in mind, Northern Dansein development projects aim to be smaller in scale, and progressive development is encouraged.
